fields.description: Schedule runs on a cron expression. Document Event runs when a record of the source doctype is created, updated or submitted — it requires the Document Query source, and runs on that one record.
fields.label: Trigger

fields.description: Leave empty (or pick Custom) to write the cron expression yourself.
fields.label: Schedule
fields.options:
Every 15 minutes
Hourly
Daily 03:00
Weekly (Mon 03:00)
Custom

fields.description: Cron expression, e.g. 0 3 * * *. The scheduler ticks every 15 minutes, so that is the effective granularity floor — anything finer still runs at most once per tick. Filled from the preset unless the preset is Custom.
fields.label: Schedule (cron)

fields.description: The document lifecycle event on the source doctype that runs this task.
fields.label: Event
fields.options:
After Insert
On Update
On Submit

fields.description: Where the task reads from. Both source types are entered by a System Manager — the LLM never supplies a URL, a doctype or a filter.
fields.label: Source Type

fields.description: The only URL this task ever fetches. Admin-entered — never supplied by the LLM.
fields.label: Source URL

fields.description: Records are read with the interface's isolation user permissions — a document that user cannot read is never seen by the model.
fields.label: Source DocType

fields.description: Admin-entered filters. Click the table to edit them.
fields.label: Source Filters

fields.description: Most records to read in one run. A run that hits this limit rewinds its watermark, so the rest is picked up on the next run.
fields.label: Row Limit

fields.description: Read only records changed since the last run. Keep this on — without it every run re-bills the model for every matching record.
fields.label: Only Changed Records

fields.description: One of the fixed interfaces.PREDEFINED names (see crema_automation_task.js — fetched from crema.api.get_interfaces, not hardcoded here).
fields.label: Interface

fields.description: Plain-English description of what to read from the source and what to do with it.
fields.label: Instruction

fields.description: Upsert Records creates or updates records of the target doctype. Update Source Records writes back onto the records the query returned — it never creates. Report Only writes nothing at all.
fields.label: Action
fields.options:
Upsert Records
Update Source Records
Report Only

fields.description: The doctype rows are upserted into. It is the fence that stops a self-written plan from writing anywhere else the isolation user can reach. The stored plan is validated against this doctype's meta.
fields.label: Target DocType

fields.description: Comma-separated addresses to email the report to after each successful run. Leave empty to only store it below.
fields.label: Email Report To

fields.description: Written by the planner on the first run and reused after. Parameters only (prompts, schemas, field maps) — never executable content. Clear it to force a replan. Not used by the Report Only action.
fields.label: Plan JSON

fields.description: What the last run did: a row count for a writing action, or the report text for Report Only.
fields.label: Last Result
